grants.description: Provide proof of your identity as the informant registering the death
grants.purpose: To confirm you are a qualified informant legally entitled to register this death

grants.description: Share details about the deceased for the death register
grants.purpose: Legal requirement to record accurate death information in the official register for England and Wales

grants.description: Share medical certificate of cause of death from attending doctor
grants.purpose: Legal requirement to record certified cause of death in the death register

grants.description: Share death registration details with multiple government departments through Tell Us Once service
grants.purpose: To notify HMRC, DWP, passport office, DVLA and other departments about the death, saving you from contacting them individually

revocation.mechanism: Contact the General Register Office to request amendments to the death register. Revocation of the death registration itself is not possible once completed.
revocation.effect: Death registration is a permanent legal record. Errors can be corrected through formal amendment process.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot act as the legal informant. Agent cannot sign the death register on your behalf. Agent cannot verify documents or provide false information. The informant must attend the register office in person or virtually to complete registration.
